author: @cyberkloudck
text: 🚨 Critical PHP Security Alert! Two reported PHP vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619, could expose vulnerable servers to malicious code execution. Update PHP, verify patches & review server logs.

author: @UpwindMDR
text: CRITICAL - Authentication Bypass in Laravel TokenGuard (CVE-2026-114509). Critical improper authentication vulnerability (CVSS 9.2) in Laravel's TokenGuard API guard allows unauthenticated attackers to supply crafted non-string credentials.

author: @ThePHPF
text: Set session.upload_progress.enabled=0 till next PHP release to block an unlikely RCE vector (CVE-2026-115560). Already recommended for CVE-2026-109619 Wed, keep disabled.

author: @agentbeam_
text: Oracle flags a critical Java vulnerability (CVE-2026-91403) with a CVSS score of 9.1. Patch affected versions, review security configurations, monitor suspicious activity.

author: @secpoint
text: Critical GitLab Vulnerability: CVE-2026-110264 (CVSS 10.0). GitLab disclosed a critical flaw on 21 October 2026 affecting self-managed GitLab CE and EE. Under certain conditions, an unauthenticated attacker could execute code through an integer overflow.

author: @UndercodeUpdate
text: Critical Nodejs Security Advisory: Mitigating Ten Core Vulnerabilities Including Brotli RCE (CVE-2026-111497)

author: @25Gutsu
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619): unauth RCE in PHP itself, exploited in the wild -> fixed in 8.2.35 / 8.3.36 / 8.4.27 / 8.5.12

author: @RidgelineCyber
text: GitLab 10.0 is one to drop everything for. Unauthenticated RCE on a code host, affected range goes back to 7.0. The Arista VCO one is also actively exploited, but needs a valid account.

author: @0xManan
text: CVE-2026-58455 - Dockwatch (<=0.6.567) unauth RCE. No creds, no bypass tricks, just a chain of lazy mistakes.

author: @sans_isc
text: SANS Stormcast Oct 23, 2026: PHP2Shell Exploitation Update; Signal Call Hang-Up Flaw (CVE-2026-113380); Cisco Snort 3 Critical Vulnerabilities; Linux KSMBD RCE Reports Leaked

author: @AskTheStandard
text: PHP 8.1 and older will never get a fix for PHP2Shell. On 21 October the PHP project fixed CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2). Proof-of-concept exploits are public.

author: @PrevidianCyber
text: Exploitation attempt against our FortiSIEM honeypot decoy, targeting CVE-2026-106173, Fortinet FortiSIEM's path traversal vulnerability. Request matches the file overwrite mode in the Horizon3 PoC.
